experiment.description: Shorts: the real person's photo or the company's logo in the first frame, against a drawn subject (judged on stayed to watch)
experiment.on: First frame for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 1, on): the hook beat shows the real subject itself: the famous person as a cut-out photo bobblehead (`"who": "photo:<name>"`) or the company's logo as a die-cut sticker (`"prop": "photo:<name>"`), big, with its name as a label and the hook figure beside it, from frame 0. Fetch it with `python -m generator.images fetch` (writer.md, real photos). If no freely licensed file exists, say so in the report and draw the subject instead.
experiment.off: First frame for this Short (weekly loop, cycle 1, off): no real photo or logo in the hook beat; draw the subject (its product, building or a cast stand-in labelled with its name), big, with the hook figure beside it. Real photos may still appear later in the video.
experiment.why: 0 of 8 Shorts a side have two days of data; day 0 of 7
